title: Bound caller numerical state at selected BIT adapter callbacks
body:
## Summary

```diff
 Consumer.apply -> stream ADD -> adapter coefficient
- PR2781's local allowance leaves caller entry residents unspecified
+ exact caller context: 0 residue Words and 12 index Words
+ conditional coefficient-phase excess: 37,672 residues and 34 indices
```

Adds only `research/selected-adapter-caller-entry/`, taking [PR2781's caller-entry handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959295). The proof counts the suspended trace generator, Geometry/Layout residents and completed extent cleanup above **all** `Consumer.apply` entry residents. Both ADD traversals see the same context. Exact runtime and callee-proof exports retain their original notices and attribution.

This is a source-level numerical-content lemma for adapter coefficient lifetimes. It assumes distinct arenas, arena-neutral observation and successful restoration by prior child calls. The composed allowance inherits PR2781's separately pinned local proof. Other caller phases, whole-node reserve, fixed physical banks, movement costs, supplier admission and kappa remain open.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2781 explicitly leaves actual surrounding caller residents uncounted. Its 22-index local allowance alone is insufficient as a caller-relative allowance.
  **After:** the source-lifetime proof gives twelve additional caller indices. Four authenticated fixtures check 213,944 source trace events, including all 48,476 adapter sites; 38 callback samples through actual action/extent boundaries pass 76 literal occupied-cell scans. Entry values, live sets, heads and serialized inputs are preserved.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes the primary calculation and ten optimized behavioral/integrity tests. Controls cover one-Word undercharging, an unpriced retained slot, exact/exhausted event capacity, source/proof corruption, source paths/inventory and typed receipts. The research-workflow suite has 67 passes and seven skips. Scoped Ruff diagnostics/format and exact Git-byte comparisons for every predecessor export pass.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -Werror -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-adapter-caller-entry
```

The probe abstracts serialized/payload traversal, record movement and coefficient bodies. It does not run a complete Boolean packet or recertify coefficient correctness. The written source proof supplies the universal lifetime implication. A separate read-only internal review found no substantive issue; no human, theorem-kernel, selected cold-replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Scientific source: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2697 `a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1`. Callee proof: Nick Petalas PR2781 `9fdbd4b0429dbfcb4569f7768b66d318deacab6b`, with PR2759/2770/2778 and retained source lineage credited. David Arias's PR2753 already supplies a coarser all-size logical inventory. The separately claimed child-coefficient, physical-bank and row-padding work remains complementary. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959666).

Started from canonical main `84f8e6077`, priority revision 5. The submission refresh retains the frozen scientific baseline and records unchanged relevant guidance, selected record, runner and dependency heads in TASK.json. The complete 22:15 UTC overlap refresh covers 727 open PRs and 1,440 Discussion/comment/reply records without warnings. Metadata searches do not establish novelty.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One opt-in package. Existing selected records, runtime sources and predecessor evidence remain unchanged.
